skills.name: simhook
skills.description: Send and receive SMS through a simhook account, where an Android phone's own SIM sends and receives behind a REST API at api.simhook.dev. Use when a task must text a phone number, follow a send to delivery, wait for an SMS reply or a verification code sent to a number the user owns, read message history, verify a simhook webhook, or set up @simhook/sdk or @simhook/mcp. Needs SIMHOOK_API_KEY.
